dog.description_text:
This beautiful and unique-looking lady is named Riley. Donning a caramel and chocolate brindle coat, and eyes like melted brownies, she can make you fall head over feet in love! Riley is seeking a loving and jubilant adult-only home, that has the gusto for a spirited lady, but will also give her the time that she deserves to become comfortable and settle in. New people make her nervous, so she'll need her future family to let her get cozy with them at her own pace. She'd also be best as the only four-legged family member in the home. Riley's adoption fee has been paid for by a generous donation from CCP Solutions!

This cutie resides at our Westhampton location. We invite you to visit, no appointment needed!
Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
dog.name: Riley
